subject: Air freight quote to BOM
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well! Could you send me an all-in price in EUR for the cheapest air freight option to BOM (Mumbai, IN), including the truck you’d arrange from our site to the departure airport?

The precision instruments will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-24 at our site in Tuebingen, Germany (postcode 72379). It’s 1 piece with a gross weight of 100 kg and a volume of 0.87 cbm.

Thanks for taking a look!

Cheers,
Klaus Weidner
Weidner Spielwaren GmbH, Nuremberg
